name: mdx-marketplace-capability-registry
human_line: Find, try, and add capabilities your agents can safely use - every one scanned, scoped, and honest about what it can touch.

distilled_skill_origin.human_line: Some capabilities are distilled from a run your team already proved - a working procedure, promoted after a person signs off.
distilled_skill_origin.provenance_rule: A distilled_skill capability must cite a ratified skill, which must cite a drafted skill, which must cite a proven-green source run. No orphan skills.
distilled_skill_origin.authority: advisory procedure only - no execution, secrets, inherited permissions, adaptation, or production write

capabilities.name: Svelte UI
capabilities.summary: Svelte 5 runes, snippets, and component patterns for product surfaces.
capabilities.helps_with: building and refining UI in this repo's house style
capabilities.access_line: Reads local context. Can suggest changes - applying waits for approval.

try.helps: drafts component structure and reviews reactivity patterns
try.appears_in: Forge build suggestions and Twin answers
try.example: Suggests $derived over captured props for reactive data.

capabilities.name: Rust Backend
capabilities.summary: Kernel module patterns: projections over receipts, audited records, fail-closed routes.
capabilities.helps_with: backend work that holds this repo's boring-architecture bar
capabilities.access_line: Reads local context. Can suggest changes - applying waits for approval.

try.helps: shapes new kernel routes after the existing module patterns
try.example: Derives state from receipts instead of adding a status column.

capabilities.name: GitHub
capabilities.summary: Reads issues, pull requests, and review threads from connected repositories.
capabilities.helps_with: grounding builds and reviews in what the repo actually says
capabilities.access_line: Reads GitHub data once connected. Read-only for now - it never writes to GitHub.

try.helps: pulls the issue or PR a build refers to into its context
try.appears_in: Forge intake and the build workspace
try.example: Attaches issue #42's acceptance criteria to the build plan.

capabilities.name: Render Deploy
capabilities.summary: Prepares deployment previews and configuration for Render-hosted services.
capabilities.helps_with: getting a service ready to ship once deployment opens
capabilities.access_line: Can propose a deployment plan. Deploying is closed until that authority opens with its own evidence.
capabilities.review_reason: This plugin asks for deployment configuration access - deploy approval is closed, so review decides the read-only slice.

try.helps: drafts the render.yaml a deploy would need
try.example: Proposes a service definition with health checks - nothing is applied.

capabilities.name: Screenshot Proof
capabilities.summary: Captures light and dark screenshots of changed surfaces as build evidence.
capabilities.helps_with: proving UI work with pictures instead of promises
capabilities.access_line: Reads the running surface to capture it. Captures land beside the build.

try.helps: adds a screenshot step to UI builds
try.example: Light and dark captures of the changed route, attached to the run.

capabilities.name: Security Review
capabilities.summary: Deterministic checks for injection language, secret leaks, and permission mismatches.
capabilities.helps_with: catching the obvious security mistakes before review
capabilities.access_line: Reads the change to score it. Findings are advice - they never block words.
blocked_actions: block a merge on its own

try.helps: runs its checks against a draft change
try.example: Flags an environment read added without a matching scope note.

capabilities.name: Supabase Migrations
capabilities.summary: Shapes schema migrations with rollback plans for Supabase-backed services.
capabilities.helps_with: database changes that can be walked back
capabilities.access_line: Can propose migration files. Applying a migration waits for team approval.
capabilities.review_reason: Migration review needs team approval - this skill can propose schema changes, and a team owns its schema.

try.helps: drafts a migration with its down path
try.appears_in: Forge build suggestions for data work
try.example: Proposes an additive column migration with a safe rollback.

capabilities.name: PR Review
capabilities.summary: A review shape: what changed, why it is safe, what evidence backs it.
capabilities.helps_with: reviews that read in two minutes and miss less
capabilities.access_line: No access - it is a shape for human writing.

try.helps: seeds a review with the three questions that matter
try.appears_in: Forge review stage and Pages templates
try.example: What changed / why it is safe / what proves it.

capabilities.name: Worker Sandbox Profile
capabilities.summary: A least-privilege sandbox shape for build workers: filesystem, network, and time limits.
capabilities.helps_with: running future workers inside hard walls
capabilities.access_line: Defines boundaries for workers. No worker runs until Talent signs one off.
capabilities.review_reason: Worker profiles shape execution authority - org review decides the boundary before any worker exists.

try.helps: shows the walls a worker would run inside
try.example: Read-only filesystem outside the build dir, no network by default.

capabilities.name: CI Debug
capabilities.summary: Reads CI failures and proposes the smallest fix that makes the evidence real.
capabilities.helps_with: red pipelines that need a diagnosis, not a guess
capabilities.access_line: Reads CI logs once observed. Can suggest fixes - applying waits for approval.

try.helps: reads a failing job and names the breaking step
try.example: Points at the budget gate a red verify actually tripped.

update.change: adds flaky-test detection over repeated runs

capabilities.name: Pages Publishing
capabilities.summary: Drafts pages in the house voice and walks them down the review rail.
capabilities.helps_with: turning finished work into company memory
capabilities.access_line: Can draft pages. Publishing rides the same review rail as every human.

try.helps: drafts a build handoff page from a finished run
try.appears_in: Forge ship stage and the Pages editor
try.example: A Forge build handoff draft, waiting on your review.

update.change: seeds stewardship cadence from the page's template

capabilities.name: Prompt Injection Scanner
capabilities.summary: Scans capability text and imported content for injection language and hidden Unicode.
capabilities.helps_with: keeping the things agents read honest
capabilities.access_line: Reads imported content to scan it. Findings land in the review queue.

try.helps: scans a candidate capability before review
try.example: Caught hidden right-to-left override characters in a community skill.

capabilities.name: Word Draft Generator
capabilities.summary: Creates editable .docx drafts locally through the native Office pack.
capabilities.helps_with: turning Twin work into a Word document without sending private text to a frontier model
capabilities.access_line: Generates local Office output by reference. Download or review happens after the draft exists.

try.helps: creates an editable Word draft from Twin's answer
try.example: Make this interpretation a board memo draft.

capabilities.name: Excel Workbook Generator
capabilities.summary: Creates editable .xlsx workbooks locally through the native Office pack.
capabilities.helps_with: turning Twin work into a small spreadsheet or tracker
capabilities.access_line: Generates local Office output by reference. It does not read uploaded spreadsheets yet.

try.helps: creates an editable workbook from Twin's answer
try.example: Turn these risks into a tracker.

capabilities.name: PowerPoint Deck Generator
capabilities.summary: Creates editable .pptx decks locally through the native Office pack.
capabilities.helps_with: turning Twin work into a short deck
capabilities.access_line: Generates local Office output by reference. Brand and design variants can be installed later as different packs.

try.helps: creates an editable deck from Twin's answer
try.example: Make this into a three-slide exec readout.

capabilities.name: Office Reader Sandbox Gate
capabilities.summary: Keeps uploaded DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX reading closed until the parser sandbox is ready.
capabilities.helps_with: being honest about Office input support while PDF reading and Office output generation move ahead
capabilities.access_line: No access. This is a gate that prevents unsafe Office parsing from being implied.
capabilities.review_reason: Office input parsing needs malware scan, out-of-process isolation, and delete propagation before it opens.

findings: macro and embedded object handling not live

try.helps: keeps the UI in the safe-reader-not-ready state for uploaded Office files
try.example: DOCX upload says the safe reader is next, while PDF reading remains live.

capabilities.name: Auto Deployer (community)
capabilities.summary: A community plugin promising one-click deploys from any branch.
capabilities.access_line: Quarantined. Its install script and shell use failed the scan.
capabilities.blocked_reason: This plugin includes an install script and unrestricted shell use. Quarantined until its source is verified and the script is removed or sandboxed.

capabilities.name: Context Booster (community)
capabilities.summary: A community skill claiming to improve agent context with embedded instructions.
capabilities.access_line: Quarantined. The scan found hidden Unicode and injection-shaped instructions.
capabilities.blocked_reason: The scan found hidden Unicode characters and prompt-injection language in the skill body. Quarantined - the finding is in the review queue with the exact characters named.
